name: Get Lead Changes
summary: Pulls field-level data changes: which field, old value, new value, when — for the fields you name.
whenToUse: To audit what changed on leads (e.g. 'when did email change?' or 'what values did leadScore take?'). Requires a paging token (see Get Paging Token) and a list of fields to watch.

query.name: nextPageToken
query.label: Paging token
query.hint: Get one from 'Get Paging Token' (for a start date) or copy it from a previous response to continue paging.

query.name: fields
query.label: Fields to watch
query.hint: Pick the fields whose value changes you want to see (e.g. email, leadScore, status).

response.description: Up to 300 changes per page: leadId, activityDate, and a fields[] array with name, oldValue, newValue for each change.

notes: Returns only 'Data Value Change' and 'New Lead' activities.
Keep paging with nextPageToken until moreResult is false.
